text: Hello Professor Alvarez — this is Sarah. I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. If you'd rather suggest another time, I'll check it against my schedule.

Hello Sarah — glad you wrote. Monday 10:00-10:30 works on my side, so I've booked it: our 30-minute 1:1, Monday 10:00-10:30. See you then. If anything changes on your side, tell me and we'll find another free slot.
Monday 10:00-10:30 is confirmed and it's on my calendar now. See you then — and I'll let you know straight away if anything changes.
